test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The room will have been cleaned by the servant.

options.text: The servant will have cleaned the room.
The servant will have clean the room.
The servant will clean the room.
The servant should clean the room.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence** "The room will have been cleaned by the servant."**__ is in the **passive voice.**
 
• To convert it to the active voice, the subject should perform the action directly.
 
• The correct active voice sentence is **"The servant will have cleaned the room."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
